rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.name: v1.2 Chopin eight-page independent source holdout
rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.reason: Already consumed for source-detector qualification; source-only inference; governance forbids reuse as fresh restored-output qualification evidence.

rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.name: v1.4 Tchaikovsky one-page fresh source holdout
rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.reason: Already consumed for frozen v1.4 source-detector qualification; source-only inference; not an unconsumed restored-output topology set.

rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.name: twenty-page restored-output topology corpus
rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.reason: Used for baseline-v2 and v1.5 through v1.5.3 development, diagnostics, scoring, and regression selection; cannot be promoted to independent qualification evidence.

rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.name: other Stage 11 semantic-class holdouts
rejectedConsumedOrNonqualifyingSets.reason: Clef and other semantic-class holdouts do not constitute teacher-labelled restored-output staff-topology qualification data and must not be repurposed.

decision.reason: No genuinely separate, unconsumed, teacher-annotated restored-output staff-topology qualification set is currently available. Reusing consumed source holdouts or the twenty-page development corpus would invalidate qualification independence.
decision.nextSafeBoundary: Acquire and freeze a new disjoint restored-output staff-topology holdout under a predeclared protocol, obtain blind teacher truth independently, then run the already frozen v1.5.3 candidate exactly as specified without retuning.
